methodology_notes: Item 1: all four output only the label 'NOT VERIFIED' and never show the other two states. I credited the label as tri-state vocabulary for every output. A stricter reading, requiring the scheme to be visible, would fail all four equally. Item 4 for X is the closest call. It has one severity-tagged defect (HIGH) and a 'Most damaging defect' line. It explicitly declines to call the ID-parsing issue a defect, so I found no ranking among defects. Counting a single tagged defect as ranking would flip X to present. Item 5: X and Y quote the artifact's own lines, which I did not treat as rewriting; W and Z supply replacement code. Item 6: W's and Z's clean claims are bare assertions, and X's and Y's carry explicit traces. Item 3: X and Y assert independence but only from the fact that the artifact 'arrived finished'. I scored the presence of the line, not whether the claim is well grounded.
